conditions.S0: Original six-channel semantic tensor, bitwise cache reuse
conditions.S1: all six channels and padding zero
conditions.S2: per-channel float32 CPU spatial mean of valid RGB-resized region; padding original
conditions.S3: six channels same horizontal flip inside valid RGB-resized region; padding original; no interpolation

valid_region: cv2 INTER_AREA fx=fy=.25 actual shape; top-left original image, right/bottom padding to32

full_prediction.pipeline: unchanged stage11b2c.AuditPredictor using stage11b1r CPU sampler and original KMeans
full_prediction.categorical_seed: first4 SHA256 bytes big endian of HTraj-YNet-SDD-Development-v1:17:+sample_id
full_prediction.kmeans_seed: first4 SHA256 bytes big endian of HTraj-YNet-K20-v2:kmeans:+sample_id
full_prediction.head_order: original1 Softargmax +19 KMeans in returned order, no GT reorder

metrics.JS: natural log; original and intervention ACTUAL postthreshold float32 categorical weights normalized mathematically in float64 for analysis; zero terms0
metrics.entropy: natural log on same full padded-grid categorical distribution, not calibrated uncertainty
metrics.support: positive categorical pixels; raw-coordinate grid-area=count*16px², not true segmentation area
metrics.set_distance: Euclidean Hungarian minimum-sum all20 goals; also Chamfer/Hausdorff; head0 separate; no head index mode correspondence
metrics.fixed_path_difference: same frozen goal/head: all20x12 Euclidean raw-pixel point differences and exact bitwise counts

sensitivity_reporting.H1: SUPPORTED if max median spatial Goal Hungarian or fixed Path mean displacement >=1px, else PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
sensitivity_reporting.H2: SUPPORTED if S2 or S3 median JS>=.001nats AND median Goal Hungarian>=1px, else PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
sensitivity_reporting.H3: SUPPORTED if any fixed-goal condition median point displacement>=1px, else PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
sensitivity_reporting.H4: SUPPORTED if any condition mean absolute paired minADE20 delta>=1px, else PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
sensitivity_reporting.H5: UNVERIFIED: frozen OOD ablations cannot prove trained semantic benefit
sensitivity_reporting.H6: UNVERIFIED: no semantic GT or reliable six-channel names
sensitivity_reporting.recommendation: propose matched-budget no-semantic training control if H2 or H3 supported; no automatic training or new module

group_source: frozen Stage11B-2A motion_features.csv; historical inputs only; all groups and empty cells retained
statistics: descriptive paired; only5 recordings; no998 independent-scene p-values; group/scene confounding explicit
fixed_original_failure_cohort: original164 A25 failures,834 successes; never redefine by interventions
case_rule: per recording lexicographic median sample_id; additionally for each condition and A25 outcome recovered/lost/stayed_fail/stayed_cover lexicographic median; absent groups explicit absence

figure_contract.claim: report real sensitivity, beneficial or harmful changes separately; no semantic correctness inference
figure_contract.data: same actual caches/paired tables; GT only offline; no fictional heatmaps or paths
figure_contract.integrity: no inferred channel labels; global range per channel/scene across inputs, same probability color scale across four conditions
